mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior 12-month average signals improving demand growth, which raises earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of triggered episodes, 20-day forward returns are negative or the median IC rank falls below 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6.0% signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressure and profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In at least 70% of triggered episodes, 60-day forward returns are negative or IC rank is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior 12-month average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings visibility and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of triggered episodes, 20-day forward returns are positive or IC rank exceeds 0.90.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above the prior 12-month average signals a tightening monetary stance that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In at least 70% of triggered episodes, 20-day forward returns are positive or IC rank is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below the prior 12-month average signals weakening demand growth, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of triggered episodes, 20-day forward returns are positive or IC rank exceeds 0.90.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.0% signals a loosening labor market that reduces wage pressure and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In at least 70% of triggered episodes, 60-day forward returns are positive or IC rank is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior 12-month average combined with a 2-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior 12-month average signals divergent demand and supply dynamics, which increase uncertainty and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 3-month YoY growth > prior 12-month average AND INDPRO 3-month YoY growth < prior 12-month average
failure_condition: In more than 60% of triggered episodes, 20-day forward returns are positive or IC rank exceeds 0.90.
